messages:
Nora (docs): Quick note  I found a couple of inconsistencies on the Optimize toolkit pages: quant profile names differ from runtime logs and some SDK snippets still use the old client constructor. Opening a small PR to fix.
Ravi (eng-ml): Thanks. Which quant names? I saw 'q4f' in telemetry but the docs show 'q4_0'.
Nora (docs): Exactly. Proposal: canonicalize on 'q4_0' in docs and add a YAML alias mapping showing runtime aliases like 'q4f'. Will add a tiny migration FAQ line.
Ivy (devex): Also update the Node examples to the async iterator stream pattern. I'll paste a short TS snippet.
Jon (engineer): I'll add a minimal Python example for recommended adaptive batching + prefix cache so readers can copy/paste.
Jon (engineer): ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = client.generate('Summarize in bullets', model='redwood-2b', max_tokens=80, batch_policy='adaptive', cache_prefix_enabled=True)
print(resp.text)
```
Ivy (devex): TS stream example: ```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
for await (const chunk of client.stream.generate({ model: 'redwood-2b', input: 'Short summary' })) { process.stdout.write(chunk.text); }
```
Ravi (eng-ml): Please avoid wording that claims quant improves accuracy. Note says quant affects memory/latency tradeoffs only.
Nora (docs): Good call. I'll merge once snippets and the YAML alias mapping are in. Target EOD.
